drills.hint: wǒ chī le — add 了 after the verb for a completed action; verbs never change form

drills.q: 'I have been to Beijing' (experience) in Chinese?
drills.hint: wǒ qù guo Běijīng — 过 marks a past experience, 'have ever done'

drills.q: 'I am eating right now' in Chinese?
drills.hint: wǒ zhèngzài chīfàn — 正在 + verb shows an action in progress

drills.q: 'The train is about to leave' in Chinese?
drills.hint: huǒchē yào kāi le — 要...了 signals an imminent action
wǒ de shǒujī bèi tōu le — 被 marks the passive; verb needs 了
kànkan — reduplicating the verb makes it brief and gentle
shuǐ — third tone, dipping
jiějie — age is built in; 妹妹 is younger sister
lǎoshī — 老 here is respectful, not 'old'
guì — opposite is 便宜 (piányi, cheap)
shǒujī — literally 'hand machine'

drills.q: The measure word for a book (一__书)?
drills.hint: yì běn shū — books take 本; 个 (gè) is the default for people/things

drills.q: Make it a yes/no question: 你去 + ___?
drills.hint: nǐ qù ma? — add 吗 to any statement for a yes/no question

drills.q: 'my book' — fill the particle: 我__书
drills.hint: wǒ de shū — 的 links possessor to noun

drills.q: 'He is taller than me' — fill: 他__我高
drills.hint: tā bǐ wǒ gāo — A + 比 + B + adjective; don't add 很

drills.q: 'two people' — which word for two: 两 or 二?
drills.hint: liǎng gè rén — use 两 before a measure word, 二 for counting
shí'èr — 'ten-two'; teens are 十 + digit
xièxie — second syllable is neutral tone
duōshao qián? — 多少 = how much, 钱 = money
wǒ bù míngbai — negate with 不 for present/general states
